scope: M22R tool remediation and bounded generator qualification; original M22 remains failed
swap: disabled: memory-swap equals memory on every container
document: JSON data string generated from independent SHA256 hexadecimal blocks; 4 bits entropy per character, about 2:1 compressible; no indexed payload, no query workload
trial_policy: persistent ES and Weir processes throughout; recreate owned index and seed1000 before each trial;20s warmup then measurement, including direct and confirmations; overload followed immediately by recovery on same data without reset or warmup

direct.http_replay_prevention: non-rewindable bodies including empty chunked GET; no GetBody, proxy or redirect

overload.definition: first passing10s arrival cohort ending within30s, with all later10s cohorts and resource samples passing

sampling.observer_namespaces: only own target PID/network; /proc/1/root/sys/fs/cgroup plus process status/fd/net; SYS_PTRACE and DAC_READ_SEARCH only for own namespace proc access; ES JVM selected by exact bootstrap main class within owned PID namespace, not launcher/tini
sampling.go_goroutines: client sampled; exact Weir artifact has no low-cost census, Weir unverified
sampling.coverage: bracket each full load and stability/recovery window; monotonic per observer; sampled maxima only

stop: any correctness audit failure, OOM/restart, ledger overrun, owner uncertainty, nondefault inventory change, activity-time unexplained network change or resource bound fails stops calibration; no product optimization or automatic retries

diagnostics.mode: timing-only same engine and fixed64 workers, no RPC or database capacity claim
diagnostics.only_correction: separate20ms expiry from unchanged5ms dispatch p99; at most8 overdue arrivals per timer wake, no spin or shifted schedules
diagnostics.correction_condition: 50ops/s wake p99 <=5ms: verify the single revised expiry/catchup policy; otherwise no evidence for a post-wake fix and stop after original three probes
diagnostics.minimum_qualification: corrected50ops/s all/read/put dispatch lag p99<=5ms, zero drop/error, complete counts and covered client resources; original result alone does not qualify corrected engine

output.overflow: retain bounded prefix, separate command metadata truncated=true, fail and Stop/Wait process group
